title: Israeli Airstrike Wounds Son of Hamas Leader Khalil al-Hayya, Kills One
detail: An Israeli airstrike in Gaza killed one Palestinian and wounded the son of Hamas senior political leader Khalil al-Hayya, marking a notable targeted strike against a senior figure's family. Al-Hayya is a senior Hamas political bureau member. The strike comes amid continued Israeli military operations across Gaza following the collapse of ceasefire negotiations.

media.caption: Israeli airstrike wounds son of Hamas political leader Khalil al-Hayya in Gaza
